entries.zh: 征討；征伐、讨伐（以武力征服）
entries.en: to conquer by arms; to wage war against

entries.zh: 征吞併；征服吞并一国（灭人之国）
entries.en: to conquer and annex a kingdom; to subdue a realm

entries.zh: 吞併；吞并（兼并土地、国土）
entries.en: to swallow up; to annex, absorb (territory or a state)

entries.zh: 占；占据、侵占（占取他人之地）
entries.en: to occupy; to seize, take possession of

entries.zh: 諫；临死之际的规劝、遗谏（弥留时进的劝言）
entries.en: admonition, counsel given at the point of death; deathbed exhortation
entries.notes: 西语词头 'Consejos alamuerte. a la ora & la muerte' 释为临终劝诫，闽南栏 lŭy chiog 中 T99 污损，部分依推断。

entries.zh: 兵部；亦作兵寶[疑]，掌军事之部（六部之一）
entries.en: the Ministry/Board of War; council of war

entries.zh: 刑部；掌刑狱司法之部（六部之一）
entries.en: the Ministry/Board of Justice (criminal cases)

entries.zh: 工部；掌工程营造修缮之部（六部之一）
entries.en: the Ministry/Board of Works (public works and repairs)

entries.zh: 吏部；掌官吏铨选之部（六部之一）
entries.en: the Ministry/Board of Offices (civil appointments)

entries.zh: 戶部；掌赋税钱粮之部（六部之一）
entries.en: the Ministry/Board of Revenue

entries.zh: 礼部；掌礼仪教化之部（六部之一）
entries.en: the Ministry/Board of Rites (ceremonies, education)

entries.zh: 宰相；最高辅臣、首相
entries.en: prime minister; chief minister of the supreme council

entries.zh: 相議；商议、共同计议
entries.en: to consult together; deliberation, counsel

entries.zh: 讒言；谗言、恶语中伤（容恶助恶之言）
entries.en: slanderous speech; malicious words, to consent to evil with one's tongue
entries.notes: 西语词头残断（'Consentir lo malo, y aullar lo -'），释义以汉字讒言与对音为主。

entries.zh: 存；保存、存留
entries.en: to preserve, keep, conserve

entries.zh: 膏；药膏、糖膏（蜜渍膏剂）
entries.en: conserve, syrup; ointment, unguent
entries.notes: conserva 在 17 世纪多指蜜渍果膏/药膏，汉字膏两义皆通，取糖膏为主。

entries.zh: 餹（糖）；糖渍蜜饯
entries.en: preserved sweetmeats; sugar conserve
entries.notes: 餹即糖之异体，conserva 作蜜饯解。

entries.zh: 蜜茶料；蜜与茶调制之饮料（蜜茶配料）
entries.en: honeyed tea ingredients; conserve of honey and tea
entries.notes: 三字组合直译为蜜、茶、料，马尼拉语境下作调制蜜茶之料解。

entries.zh: 蜜餹；蜜饯、蜜糖（蜜渍糖品）
entries.en: honey-sugar conserve; candied sweetmeats

entries.zh: 泡茶；用开水冲沏茶叶（原字或作泡/疱）
entries.en: to infuse, steep tea; to brew tea
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注异文[疑:泡/疱]，取泡茶义，confidence 降为 medium。
